feed.title: MTG Kernel Weekly
feed.subtitle: One small chart a week about what a self-taught Magic: The Gathering agent learned.

entry.title: #1: Past a million updates, the bot is still climbing
entry.summary: Each doubling of training still buys wins against the model the chains started from. It just buys fewer than it used to: about 2.5 win-rate points per doubling past a million updates.
